name: Kohima
description: Capital city of Nagaland and headquarters of Kohima district, perched on hills at about 1,444 m elevation. Main gateway and base for exploring Angami Naga culture, WWII history, and nearby valleys and peaks.
facts: Connected by road from Dimapur airport/rail (about 74 km)
